long_biography.plain_text:
At thirteen, Jeroen Kool appeared on Dutch television with an invention for cyclists: a tyre containing a spare inner tube. His idea was to let a rider continue after a puncture without stopping to patch the damaged tube. The design won a cash prize on De Nationale Ideeënbus.

In his property business, Kool used database searches to identify potential purchases from land-registry records. The team contacted owners and recorded their willingness to sell and asking prices, turning the search into an organised operation. Alongside this technical work, he dealt with contractors and the municipality and kept the business's administration in order.

confidence.reason: The distinctive childhood episode and operating method are explicit in the fully read Quote report, accessed through an attributed republication. That dependence limits confidence below the independently corroborated short biography; no commercial success, patent status or causal psychological inference is added.

long_biography.html:
At thirteen, Jeroen Kool appeared on Dutch television with an invention for cyclists: a tyre containing a spare inner tube. His idea was to let a rider continue after a puncture without stopping to patch the damaged tube. The design won a cash prize on De Nationale Ideeënbus.

In his property business, Kool used database searches to identify potential purchases from land-registry records. The team contacted owners and recorded their willingness to sell and asking prices, turning the search into an organised operation. Alongside this technical work, he dealt with contractors and the municipality and kept the business's administration in order.
